candidate.answerReason: The six available sevenths form three groups of two sevenths, using all the paper.

methods.label: Group the sevenths
methods.explanation: Each portion uses two of the six available sevenths. Grouping them in pairs gives \(6 \div 2 = 3\) portions, using all the paper. Thus \(\frac{6}{7} \div \frac{2}{7} = 3\).
methods.levelReason: Counting groups of equal fractional units uses Grade 6 fraction meaning and elementary division.
